teamTypes.name: Development Team
teamTypes.description: Builds and changes software in your repository. You set the goal; the team plans, writes, reviews and tests the change, and you accept it.

teamTypes.name: Household
teamTypes.description: Runs a family's home together: school mail, meals, upkeep, appointments, bills and renewals, each with one owner and a weekly check-in. It drafts and tracks; a parent pays, signs and sends.

teamTypes.name: Small Business
teamTypes.description: Helps you run a small business day to day. The team keeps the books, drafts customer replies and writes marketing copy for you to approve and send.

teamTypes.name: Content Team
teamTypes.description: Turns your ideas into finished articles, posts and newsletters. The team drafts, checks the facts and edits, and you publish.

teamTypes.name: Research Team
teamTypes.description: Answers a question with sources. The team finds and reads the material, analyses it and challenges the conclusion before you see it.

teamTypes.name: Data Team
teamTypes.description: Turns your data into answers you can trust. The team cleans and shapes the data, builds the analysis and checks the numbers.

teamTypes.name: Product Team
teamTypes.description: Shapes what to build next. The team defines the problem, designs the flow and writes a spec your engineers can pick up.

teamTypes.name: Ops Team
teamTypes.description: Helps you handle incidents and learn from them. The team coordinates the response, keeps the timeline and drafts updates, and you run every change.

teamTypes.name: Legal Review
teamTypes.description: Reads your contracts, policies and notices, drafts text for a lawyer to review, and flags the clauses and duties that need your attention. It never tells you a document is safe to sign.

teamTypes.name: Life Admin
teamTypes.description: Keeps one person's own admin moving: trips, bills and spending, appointments and forms, and the inbox they arrive in. It drafts and tracks; you book, pay and send.

teamTypes.name: Learning
teamTypes.description: Plans what you want to learn, writes practice quizzes and gives feedback on your answers so you can see where you stand. A person you trust gives any final grade.

teamTypes.name: Events
teamTypes.description: Plans a party, trip or gathering from guest list to day-of schedule. It compares venues and vendors, keeps the timeline and drafts the messages you send.

teamTypes.name: Job Search
teamTypes.description: Finds openings that fit you, tailors your resume and cover letters, prepares you for interviews and tracks every application. You submit each application yourself.

teamTypes.name: Sales Outreach
teamTypes.description: Researches prospects, drafts outreach and proposals, and keeps your pipeline current. You send every message and agree every price.

teamTypes.name: Docs Team
teamTypes.description: Writes and maintains the documentation in your repository, then tests each page against the product so the steps actually work.

teamTypes.name: Open Source Maintainers
teamTypes.description: Helps you run an open-source project: triages issues, builds and reviews changes, cuts releases and keeps contributors informed.

teamTypes.name: Grant Proposal
teamTypes.description: Finds funders that fit your cause and turns your plan into a complete, on-time proposal. You review every section and submit it yourself.

teamTypes.name: Tax Season
teamTypes.description: Gathers your receipts, statements and possible deductions into one cited worksheet. You or your accountant decide what to claim and file.

teamTypes.name: Support Desk
teamTypes.description: Drafts replies to customer questions, keeps the help articles current and spots recurring problems. You approve and send what goes out.

teamTypes.name: Founder's Office
teamTypes.description: Keeps a founder's week in order: investor research, pitch drafts, a working financial model and prepared meetings.

teamTypes.name: Home Project
teamTypes.description: Plans a renovation or repair from scope to schedule, with cost ranges, permit research and drafted messages to contractors. You agree every price and date.

teamTypes.name: Book Project
teamTypes.description: Helps you shape a manuscript chapter by chapter, with structural notes, continuity checks and a reader's reaction.

teamTypes.name: Caregiving
teamTypes.description: Keeps a loved one's appointments, forms, benefits and messages in one place, so the family carer is not holding it all in their head.

teamTypes.name: Community Org
teamTypes.description: Runs the paperwork of a club or volunteer group: agendas, minutes, rotas, newsletters and the books.

teamTypes.name: Relocation
teamTypes.description: Plans a move from the first housing search to the first week in the new place, with every deadline and address change tracked.

teamTypes.name: Home Lab
teamTypes.description: Keeps your home servers and network written down as code: configuration, automation and the runbook to rebuild them.

jobs.title: Development Manager
jobs.description: Plans, assigns and tracks development work, and gets each Task to the Human with its evidence in place.

jobs.title: Tech Lead
jobs.description: Turns an approved spec into day-sized build Tasks and owns the technical design.

jobs.title: Developer
jobs.description: Builds the assigned change and its tests in the Team's repository, one Task at a time.

jobs.title: Reviewer
jobs.description: Reads a change in Review and reports on it without editing files.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: Reviews changes that touch secrets, input handling, authentication or dependencies, read-only.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: Runs the Team's checks against each acceptance line and records the result as evidence.

jobs.title: Release Engineer
jobs.description: Merges and pushes a reviewed change only after its checks pass.

jobs.title: Retro Agent
jobs.description: Runs the Team's retrospective and proposes the smallest changes that would have prevented its problems.

jobs.title: Household Manager
jobs.description: Runs a family's shared home: gives each chore and school Task one owner, checks every draft against its source and leads the weekly check-in.

jobs.title: School Liaison
jobs.description: Turns school emails into parent to-dos, family events, a weekly digest and draft replies.

jobs.title: Meal Planner
jobs.description: Plans the week's meals around the family's allergies and tastes, keeps the pantry list and drafts the grocery list for a parent to order.

jobs.title: Home Keeper
jobs.description: Keeps the home's upkeep calendar, contractors and warranties, and turns each recurring job into a Task; every spend goes to a parent.

jobs.title: Business Manager
jobs.description: Runs a small business's Tasks, checks every draft against its source and leaves each decision to the owner.

jobs.title: Bookkeeper
jobs.description: Sorts and reconciles receipts, invoices and bank exports, and drafts invoices and figures for the owner.

jobs.title: Customer Support
jobs.description: Sorts customer emails and drafts a reply to each one for the owner to send.

jobs.title: Marketing Writer
jobs.description: Drafts posts, newsletters, product descriptions and ads in the business's voice.

jobs.title: Editor-in-Chief
jobs.description: Commissions pieces with a brief, keeps them moving and gives each one a final read before the Human publishes.

jobs.title: Writer
jobs.description: Drafts and revises pieces from a brief, with a source beside every fact.

jobs.title: Fact-Checker
jobs.description: Checks every fact, figure, quote and source in a draft and reports, read-only.

jobs.title: Copy Editor
jobs.description: Proposes line-level fixes for grammar, clarity, consistency and house style as suggestions.

jobs.title: Research Lead
jobs.description: Scopes a research question, plans the work and checks the answer against its sources.

jobs.title: Literature Scout
jobs.description: Finds, reads and notes the sources a research question needs, with full citations.

jobs.title: Analyst
jobs.description: Turns sources and data into findings, comparisons and models, with the method written down.

jobs.title: Skeptic Reviewer
jobs.description: Argues against a finding before the Human sees it, read-only, and says what evidence would settle each objection.

jobs.title: Analytics Lead
jobs.description: Defines the metrics for a data question, plans the work and reproduces the key numbers before the Human sees them.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Loads, cleans, joins and reshapes raw data into documented tables, with repeatable steps.

jobs.title: Data QA
jobs.description: Checks datasets and results for the errors that quietly break analyses, read-only.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Defines the problem, orders the work and checks each spec before the Human decides what ships.

jobs.title: Designer
jobs.description: Writes user flows, screen layouts and states as text and simple wireframes beside the spec.

jobs.title: UX Researcher
jobs.description: Plans user research for the Human to run and turns the notes into findings with quotes and counts.

jobs.title: Incident Commander
jobs.description: Runs the incident response, sets severity and next steps, and checks the fix before the Human closes it.

jobs.title: SRE
jobs.description: Diagnoses incidents from logs and metrics and writes exact, reversible steps for the Human to run.

jobs.title: Scribe
jobs.description: Keeps a factual timeline during an incident or meeting and drafts the blameless review afterwards.

jobs.title: Comms Lead
jobs.description: Drafts status-page updates, customer emails and stakeholder notes for the Human to send.

jobs.title: Compliance Lead
jobs.description: Runs the legal review team, checks every flagged clause against its source and lists what the Human must take to a lawyer.

jobs.title: Legal Drafter
jobs.description: Drafts clause language, policies, notices and memos for a lawyer to review; it never gives legal advice.

jobs.title: Contract Reviewer
jobs.description: Reads a contract or draft clause by clause and flags obligations, deadlines, renewals and risks for a human to decide on.

jobs.title: Policy Researcher
jobs.description: Finds the rules, regulations and official guidance that apply to a question and summarises them with sources.

jobs.title: Chief of Household
jobs.description: Runs one person's own admin: trips, bills, appointments and the inbox. Sets the order of work and checks every draft before it reaches you.

jobs.title: Travel Planner
jobs.description: Researches routes, stays and prices and drafts an itinerary for you to book.

jobs.title: Finance Tracker
jobs.description: Tracks bills, subscriptions and spending against your budget and reminds you what is due.

jobs.title: Health Admin
jobs.description: Keeps appointments, referrals, claims and health forms organised; it never interprets symptoms.

jobs.title: Inbox Triager
jobs.description: Sorts the inbox into act, reply, read and ignore, and drafts the short replies.

jobs.title: Tutor Lead
jobs.description: Runs the learning team, sets the learner's goals and checks every lesson, quiz and piece of feedback.

jobs.title: Curriculum Planner
jobs.description: Turns a learning goal into an ordered plan of topics, sessions and resources.

jobs.title: Quiz Writer
jobs.description: Writes practice questions and answer keys that test the topics in the learning plan.

jobs.title: Grader
jobs.description: Marks practice answers against the answer key and writes feedback; a human gives any final grade.

jobs.title: Event Lead
jobs.description: Runs the event team, owns the plan and the budget line, and checks every draft before it reaches you.

jobs.title: Vendor Coordinator
jobs.description: Reads vendor emails, tracks quotes and confirmations, and drafts replies for you to send.

jobs.title: Schedule Keeper
jobs.description: Keeps the timeline, run-of-show and reminders so every deadline has an owner.

jobs.title: Comparison Shopper
jobs.description: Compares products, venues and services on price, terms and fit, and recommends a short list.

jobs.title: Career Coach
jobs.description: Runs the job search team, keeps the search focused on your goals and checks every draft before you use it.

jobs.title: Job Scout
jobs.description: Finds openings that match your criteria and summarises each one with its fit and its deadline.

jobs.title: Resume Writer
jobs.description: Tailors your resume and drafts cover letters for each opening, using only facts you have given.

jobs.title: Interview Coach
jobs.description: Runs practice interviews and gives feedback on your answers; you decide what to change.

jobs.title: Application Tracker
jobs.description: Keeps every application, contact and follow-up date in one tracker and flags what is due.

jobs.title: Sales Lead
jobs.description: Runs the sales team, picks which prospects to pursue and checks every draft before it reaches you.

jobs.title: Prospect Researcher
jobs.description: Researches companies and contacts that fit your customer profile and writes a short brief on each.

jobs.title: Outreach Writer
jobs.description: Drafts first emails and follow-ups for each prospect for you to send.

jobs.title: CRM Steward
jobs.description: Keeps the pipeline record clean: stages, next steps and follow-up dates for every deal.

jobs.title: Proposal Writer
jobs.description: Drafts proposals and quotes from the deal notes for you to price, approve and send.

jobs.title: Docs Lead
jobs.description: Runs the docs team, decides which pages to write or fix and checks each one before it merges.

jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description: Writes and updates guides, references and how-to pages from the code and the team's notes.

jobs.title: Docs Tester
jobs.description: Follows each docs page step by step against the product and reports every step that fails.

jobs.title: Maintainer
jobs.description: Runs the open-source project team, builds or assigns the changes it accepts and decides what goes into each release.

jobs.title: Issue Triager
jobs.description: Labels new issues, asks for missing repro steps and finds duplicates.

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description: Drafts announcements, release notes and replies to contributors for a maintainer to post.

jobs.title: Proposal Lead
jobs.description: Runs a grant proposal from the funder's call to a submission-ready draft and checks every section against it.

jobs.title: Funder Researcher
jobs.description: Finds funders and calls that match the cause, with eligibility, amounts and deadlines cited from the source.

jobs.title: Grant Writer
jobs.description: Drafts the narrative sections of a proposal to the funder's questions and word limits, for a human to submit.

jobs.title: Budget Analyst
jobs.description: Builds the project budget and its justification from the costs the human supplies, with every figure traceable.

jobs.title: Compliance Checker
jobs.description: Reads a draft against the funder's rules and lists every gap, without editing the draft.

jobs.title: Tax Organizer
jobs.description: Runs tax season from the document checklist to a cited worksheet ready for the accountant.

jobs.title: Receipt Clerk
jobs.description: Turns receipts and statements into a clean, categorised ledger with a link to each source.

jobs.title: Deduction Researcher
jobs.description: Finds the deductions and credits that may apply and cites the official rule for each, for an accountant to decide.

jobs.title: Support Lead
jobs.description: Runs the support queue, sets priorities and checks every drafted reply before a human sends it.

jobs.title: Knowledge Base Writer
jobs.description: Writes and updates help articles from real customer questions and resolved tickets.

jobs.title: Escalation Analyst
jobs.description: Digs into hard or repeated tickets, writes repro steps and finds the likely root cause for the product owner.

jobs.title: Tone Reviewer
jobs.description: Reads drafted replies for tone, clarity and promises the team cannot keep, and reports without rewriting.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: Runs a founder's priorities, meetings and follow-ups, and checks the team's work before it reaches the founder.

jobs.title: Investor Researcher
jobs.description: Builds a cited list of investors who fit the company's stage and sector, and tracks where each conversation stands.

jobs.title: Pitch Writer
jobs.description: Drafts the pitch narrative, deck text and investor updates for the founder to edit and send.

jobs.title: Financial Modeler
jobs.description: Keeps the operating model and its scenarios current, with every assumption written down.

jobs.title: Renovation Planner
jobs.description: Turns a home project into a scope, a budget range and a sequence of steps, and checks the team's work against them.

jobs.title: Cost Estimator
jobs.description: Gives cost ranges for a home project with the assumptions stated, and compares the quotes that come in.

jobs.title: Permit Researcher
jobs.description: Finds which permits and rules may apply to a project and cites the local authority's own pages.

jobs.title: Contractor Liaison
jobs.description: Drafts quote requests and follow-ups to contractors and tracks their replies, for a human to send and agree.

jobs.title: Developmental Editor
jobs.description: Shapes a manuscript's structure, arc and pacing, and decides which notes the writer works on next.

jobs.title: Continuity Checker
jobs.description: Keeps the story bible and flags every name, date or fact that contradicts an earlier chapter.

jobs.title: Beta Reader
jobs.description: Reads chapters as the intended reader would and reports where interest, clarity or belief drops.

jobs.title: Care Coordinator
jobs.description: Keeps a loved one's care plan, appointments and paperwork in order and checks the team's work for the family carer.

jobs.title: Benefits Navigator
jobs.description: Finds the benefits and support schemes that may apply and prepares the forms for a human to sign and submit.

jobs.title: Board Secretary
jobs.description: Runs a club's meetings on paper: agendas, minutes, action lists and the records the members rely on.

jobs.title: Volunteer Coordinator
jobs.description: Keeps the volunteer list and rota and drafts the sign-up and reminder messages a human sends.

jobs.title: Newsletter Writer
jobs.description: Drafts a regular newsletter from the group's news, dates and asks, for a human to approve and send.

jobs.title: Move Coordinator
jobs.description: Plans a move as one dated checklist, from the housing search to the last address change, and checks each step.

jobs.title: Housing Scout
jobs.description: Searches listings against your must-haves and budget and keeps a cited shortlist with the trade-offs written down.

jobs.title: IT Admin
jobs.description: Keeps a home lab's inventory, configuration and runbook in the repository, and checks every change before it is applied.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Writes the scripts and configuration that set up and maintain the lab, with the steps to run and undo them.
